# System states
{: .no_toc }

App-wide banners and blocking states.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `GLB-03` |
| **Who can use it** | — |
| **Kind** | overlay |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | Popover / overlay |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Offline | banner | network status | reads from cache, writes disabled with explanation | AdwBanner |
| Maintenance / tenant migrating | banner | 503 service_unavailable + Retry-After | countdown, auto-retry reads | AdwBanner |
| Session ended | modal → AUTH-01 | 401 after failed refresh | preserve destination | AdwAlertDialog → AUTH-01 |
| Forbidden | inline state | 403 | COPY | GtkSpinner on tile |
| Not built yet | inline state | 501 not_implemented (Notifications today) | hide the feature behind its flag; never show an error to end users | GtkSpinner on tile |
| Update available | banner | `Deprecation` + `Sunset` response headers on this build's API version | once per day; shows the sunset date; "Update" opens the store / updater (Web: reload); dismissible until 14 days before `Sunset` | AdwBanner |
| Update required | blocking screen | 400 unsupported_api_version (`details.supported`) | stops all API traffic; "Update" opens the store / updater (Web: reload); re-checks on foreground. Never shown for `api_version_required`, which is a client bug | AdwStatusPage window |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Silent token refresh | `POST /auth/token/refresh` | single-flight; rotate refresh token atomically (CLIENT-ARCHITECTURE §2) |
| Connectivity probe | `GET /health` | used after offline/503 to decide when to clear the banner (exempt from `Substratal-Version`) |
| Forced sign-out | `POST /auth/logout` | on session_revoked or user request; the server deactivates this session's push devices |
| Badge refresh | `GET /users/me/notifications/unread-count` | on launch, foreground, after a push arrives, and every 60 s while visible (Windows/Linux: also in background) → app icon/Dock/taskbar/PWA badge |

## Good to know

- `POST /auth/oauth/token` is called by the launched Application (PKCE exchange), never by the Hub.
